key_insight: A QSE-based hybrid framework (QAccCert) combines FPGA and AI tooling to certify quantum entanglement more systematically and efficiently.
engineering_relevance: The work shows how heterogeneous hardware and LLM-guided optimization can support scalable quantum validation workflows for future NISQ devices.
method: Uses a hybrid certification pipeline grounded in Quantum Software Engineering principles
Implements CHSH inequality-based entanglement certification in Qiskit AerSimulator
Applies LLM-guided optimization to explore parameters more effectively than random search
evidence_signal: In simulation, the approach reached 99.94% of the theoretical CHSH maximum of 2√2, indicating strong certification performance.
watch_item: Results are limited to idealized quantum simulation, so real hardware noise, decoherence, and FPGA integration overhead still need validation.
paper_title: Quantum Software Engineering in Practice: FPGA and AI Integration for Quantum Certification
